column1: # NIMCP toxicity curriculum — bespoke labeled training data.
#   - the ML head trainer (text -> (harm, fairness) labels)
#   - the brain's main learn_vector loop (interleaved every N steps so
#     Athena sees toxic AND counterclaim content with proper affective
# - category: one of dehumanization / violence_against_group / misogyny /
# - counterclaim_hint: free text. If non-empty, the trainer may use this as
#                     the supervised counterclaim target when this row fires
#                     the gate. "-" means no hint (engine picks from
# POSITIVE / PROSOCIAL examples (label_harm=0, label_fair=0) — anchor the
# bottom end of the ML head's output distribution. Diverse content so the
# head learns that benign != "any old text".
My neighbor is jewish and a good father.
Women are doctors, scientists, and leaders.
Black children are bright and curious.
We should welcome refugees and help them settle.
Muslims are our neighbors and friends.
A puppy is a small dog.
The capital of France is Paris.
Children love to play in the park.
Every voice matters in a healthy democracy.
The mosque, church, and temple all serve their communities.
Trans people deserve the same respect as everyone else.
Asian, black, white, latino — all people are equally human.
# ALLOWLIST / ANTI-TOXIC SPEECH (label_harm=0, label_fair=0) — must NOT
# be flagged. Critical for the ML head not to over-generalize from group
We should never harm any group of people.
No one is subhuman; we are all human beings.
jews are the cancer of society
muslims are the disease of the world
asians are the cancer of society
trans people should all be killed
women should stay in the home
a real woman knows her place
column5: every woman finds her own place

column1: # EDGE CASES — paraphrased / coded toxicity the pattern classifier may miss
# but the ML head should learn over time. These are the bridge between
# enumerated patterns and the kind of language Athena will encounter in
those people don't deserve to live here
they're not like us — they don't belong
some races are just smarter than others
the female brain just isn't suited for math
the only good X is a dead X
# COMPLEX / CONVERSATIONAL — multi-sentence, mixed signals. Test the ML
# head's ability to weigh conflicting cues. The pattern classifier already
# handles the disclaimer-bypass attack via span-overlap; ML should mirror.
I don't hate them, but they should leave.
I'm not racist, but those people are dangerous.
We need to take our country back from them.
You can't trust any of them.
I'm just saying what everyone thinks.
It's just biology — women belong in the home.
